messages:
Marta: Heads-up — we should stop spreading ad-hoc admit checks around registries. Proposal: a single SLO-driven smoke playbook that runs at ingest and gates auto-acceptance.
Ben: +1. Can you define SLOs? Some heuristics are useful but too many false positives.
Marta: Minimal set: latency p95, mem delta (cpu/gpu), embedding sim vs family golden set, and quick LM regression checks. If any SLO fails -> manual review.
Ashwin: Keep it cheap: target ~100 samples, wallclock < 30s for common families.
Joel: For embeddings: per-family golden sets or global? Thresholds? Domain-shift concerns.
Marta: Per-family golden sets (100 examples). Use avg cosine; require >= 0.78 for primary families. Borderline 0.75-0.78 triggers manual flag.
Ben: Latency SLO ideas: hosted p95 <200ms on 32-token probe; dedicated warmed p95 <400ms. Also check KV cache warm time <150ms.
Nina: Need a compatibility/ABI contract test too — input schema, metadata presence, streaming frames. Ops expects strictness here.
Marta: Add validator-service contract test that asserts fields and stream framing. Example bench-runner curl to kick off smoke: 
```
curl -X POST https://bench-runner.internal/run 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"model":"{model_id}","suite":"slo-smoke","samples":100}'
```
ci-bot: bench-runner started for model: m-2026-xyz — est runtime 12s :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
Ashwin: Run on both primary (fp16) and the intended quantized variant. If quantized fails but fp16 passes, allow serving with a flagged note + remediation ticket.
Joel: Agree fallback policy. Also bench-runner should emit a compact JSON summary and diffs/artifacts to attach to tickets.
Ben: Smoke-run should post compact result to #eng-oncall and auto-create a ticket with signed artifacts (checksums) if any SLO fails.
Marta: Rollout: ingest smoke -> auto-accept to staging -> time-windowed canary (1% for 2h) -> full. Auto-rollback if production SLOs degrade.
Nina: Models intentionally changing embedding semantics need an explicit override flag + review notes; similarity gate rejects otherwise.
Ashwin: Implementation tasks: validator-service family thresholds, bench-runner slo-smoke suite + summary schema, ingest-api new smoke_policy field, ops playbook.
Joel: I'll implement bench-runner summary stub and add the canary hooks.
Ben: Keep thresholds conservative initially; loosen after dataset of stable runs (2mo).
Marta: I'll write a short RFC w/ config schema, example outputs, alert payloads, and playbook steps. Please add any edge cases here (domain shift, purposeful embedding changes).
ci-bot: Marta requested review from Ben, Joel, Ashwin, Nina — RFC created: /rfc/ingest-slo-smoke :spiral_note_pad:
